questions.question: On a municipal account, consumption is calculated by:
options: Subtracting the previous meter reading from the current reading
Adding this month's reading to last month's
Multiplying the basic charge by the tariff
Dividing the total due by the number of days

questions.question: Electricity of 285 kWh at R2,40 per kWh, plus a basic charge of R160, gives a subtotal of:
VAT at 15% on a subtotal of R844,00 comes to:
To find the pre-VAT amount from a VAT-inclusive total of R970,60, you must:
A salary of R11 200 that arrives in the identical amount every month is:
Wages of R32,00 per hour for a 38-hour week come to:
Commission of 4% on sales of R38 500 is:
A once-off birthday gift from an aunt is classified as:
options: Fixed income, because family can be relied on
Variable income, because the amount differs
Occasional income, because it follows no timetable

questions.question: Taxi fares of R16,00 a trip, two trips a day for 21 working days, total:
Taxi fare repeats every working day, yet it counts as variable because:
options: The AMOUNT is not guaranteed — a public holiday or a lift changes the month's total
It costs less than the rent

questions.question: With income of R14 000 and total expenditure of R11 052, the household has:
A budget that ends in a deficit is best described as:
options: Evidence that all income is fixed
Proof that every expense is occasional
A written plan to borrow, so a variable expense should be trimmed

subtopics.title: Simple Interest: the Price of Borrowed Money

questions.question: Simple interest is computed each year on:
options: The principal plus interest already added

questions.question: The simple interest on a loan of R6 500 at 14% per year for 2 years is:
The total repaid on that loan — principal plus interest — is:
A rate quoted per year, applied to a loan running 30 months, needs the time entered as:
The basic charge of R160 on the statement is owed:
options: For the connection itself, even in a month of zero consumption
Only once the account falls into arrears

questions.question: Arrears on a municipal statement means:
options: An estimate of next month's usage
Last month's unpaid balance carried onto this month's statement
The deposit paid when the account opened
The VAT portion of the bill

questions.question: Given only the bottom line of R970,60 including VAT, the pre-VAT amount is found by:
options: Dividing by 1,15 to return to R844

questions.question: When budgeting with variable income like commission, you should enter:
options: An ordinary month's figure, never the record high
The December figure, because it was the biggest
The average of the two best months

questions.question: Rent, stokvel contributions and school fees belong in the same drawer because they are:
options: Fixed expenses — the same figure every month

questions.question: The new school uniform in January is the classic example of:
options: An occasional expense that catches families who never set money aside

questions.question: With R14 000 flowing in and R11 052 flowing out, the water-tank picture says:
options: The tank is falling — a deficit
The tank is rising — a surplus of R2 948

questions.question: On a simple-interest loan of R6 500 at 14% per year, the interest charged in the second year is:
options: R910 — identical to year one, because it is measured on the original amount
More than in the first year
Less than in the first year
Nothing, because the loan is almost settled

questions.question: The gap between the R6 500 sticker price and the R8 320 actually repaid is:
options: R1 820 — the price of borrowing for two years
